input.body:
Dear Landlord,

Thank you for your email about 8 Whitby Row, Ellesford, ZZ1 8ZZ (ref R/9).

I have passed the rent arrears and the deposit from the previous tenancy to a member of our lettings team. They will contact you to discuss both and the options available.

We are not able to arrange a lock change to keep the tenant out of the property. Excluding a tenant without a court order can amount to unlawful eviction, so please do not change the locks or restrict his access in the meantime. Our team can explain the lawful routes when they are in touch.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance Operations
